P8q: Medical care is one of the toughest connections to work out. A community may prefer natural care, but what happens if someone in the community needs trauma surgery, antibiotics, dentistry, emergency obstetric care, or any number of specialist services? The community really needs to hash out in advance how people in it are going to have access to these services. What will be guaranteed out of what the community shares? What may require money from outside sources (or insurance)? And how will it treat people who want different levels of care?
P8e: Access to medical care is one of the trickiest connections to sort out. A community may prefer natural care, but what if someone in the community needs trauma surgery, antibiotics, dental care, obstetric care in an emergency, or a specialist? The community needs to hash out in advance how members will have access to care, what kinds of care will be ensured by what it shares, what kinds of care might need to be accessed through outside sources of money (or insurance), and how to treat people who want to access different levels of care.
